**Resolution:** Headless core, Ghost-only AI and the scene/events boundary are fixed. TypeScript/web is a working preference until the source study settles it. Reuse methrep's contract, not its date-only event append algorithm.

# Represent
> Root workspace for all **LLM-based visual representation** projects under waremoto.
> Lives at `D:/ware/represent`. Repo: <https://github.com/Jlabarca/represent>

Represent is the umbrella for tools, POCs, and products that turn source code (and other structured inputs) into artistic visual representations — dependency graphs, creatures, cities, blueprints, animated minimaps, 3D meshes. A project should have an iconic visual identity that reflects its real structure, not just a logo. Developers should look at the picture and understand relationships they'd otherwise have to read thousands of lines to recover.
Multiple concrete projects will live here. They share one doctrine, one AI backend, and one embeddability target — differ only in their visualization mode and ingestion strategy.

# Grafe MVP validation

Grafe is a local, zero-model source explorer. These pilots test whether a bounded deterministic index can give useful navigation and evidence on real repositories while keeping manual refresh predictable. It rebuilds the configured source scope on refresh; it does not claim a per-file incremental compiler cache. The dependency is TypeScript 5.9.3, pinned under `src/grafe/` and installed with lifecycle scripts disabled.
## Real project pilots

The pilot configuration in [`examples/grafe/real-projects.json`](../../examples/grafe/real-projects.json) points to Plane Sync and Represent. The full machine report is in [`real-project-audit.json`](real-project-audit.json). It records selected file and byte counts, symbols, typed relationships, grouped diagnostics, indexing time, no-op identity, and a controlled one-file refresh performed on a temporary copy.

# plane-sync

Two-way bridge between **GhostDev's methodology daemon (methrep)** and a **self-hosted [Plane](https://plane.so)** instance. IMPL checklist steps appear as Plane work items; moving a Plane card to Done/Cancelled flips the checkbox in the IMPL markdown. The markdown stays the single source of truth.
